from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0031.png"))
# Stool top
mask_top = (img[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img[:, :, 0] < 160) & (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 90) & (img[:, :, 2] < 50)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_top)
print(f"Stool top in 31: xs=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], cx={xs.mean():.1f}")

# Find lowest leg pixel
mask_legs = (img[:, :, 0] > 50) & (img[:, :, 0] < 95) & (img[:, :, 1] > 55) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img[:, :, 2] > 65) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
cond = mask_legs & (np.arange(512)[None, :] >= xs.min() - 10) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] <= xs.max() + 10) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > ys.max())
ys_l, xs_l = np.where(cond)
print(f"Stool legs in 31: bottom={ys_l.max()}")
'", "description": "Find stool ground contact in obs_0031"}

{"command": "python3 -c "
import numpy as np

f = 256.0
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5
h = 1.55

# In F24: previous pose was (1.250, 2.933), heading was 30 deg.
# Action was: turn_deg = -90 (new heading = -60 deg = 300 deg), move_m = 0.5.
# dx = 0.5 * sin(-60 deg) = 0.5 * (-0.866025) = -0.433
# dy = 0.5 * cos(-60 deg) = 0.5 * 0.5 = 0.250
pos_x = 1.250 - 0.433
pos_y = 2.933 + 0.250
heading_rad = np.radians(-60.0)
print(f'F24 Pose: ({pos_x:.3f}, {pos_y:.3f}), heading -60 deg')

# Lamp base: y_max = 458, x_mean = 377.3
z_cam = f * h / (458.0 - cy)
x_cam = (377.3 - cx) * z_cam / f
x_w = pos_x + z_cam * np.sin(heading_rad) + x_cam * np.cos(heading_rad)
y_w = pos_y + z_cam * np.cos(heading_rad) - x_cam * np.sin(heading_rad)
print(f'F24 Lamp base: z_cam={z_cam:.3f}, x_cam={x_cam:.3f} -> World: X={x_w:.3f}, Y={y_w:.3f}')
""}
